title: Rebuild store_screenshots_test.dart's Progress/Scheduler/Achievements goldens from real screens instead of in-file mockup widgets
why: Screenshots 3-5 build their entire UI from private classes defined at the bottom of this same test file (_StatCard, _WeeklyChart, _CurriculumProgress, _MilestoneItem, _TaskItem, _SummaryRow, _AchievementTile) with hand-picked constants ('2,847', '47 days left', a fixed achievement list) — the file imports no widget from lib/features/progress, lib/features/scheduler's screen, or any real achievements screen. matchesGoldenFile for these 3 tests therefore only confirms the test file's own copy-pasted mockup still matches its own previous mockup; a real regression or redesign in ProgressScreen/SchedulerScreen/the achievements screen cannot make these tests fail, which is the textbook tautological-test pattern the audit is hunting for, while the file still counts toward AG-3's line cap and the suite's golden/coverage budget as if it were regression coverage.
recommendation: Either move this file out of test/ and label it as a marketing-asset generator (e.g. tool/screenshots/), or rebuild Screenshots 3-5 by pumping the actual ProgressScreen/SchedulerScreen/achievements widgets with seeded providers so a real UI regression trips the golden.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots 3-5 either import and render the production screen/widget under test, or the file is relocated with a doc comment disclaiming it as non-regression marketing collateral

corrections: Primary rule is better cited as TQ-8 (digest explicitly assigns 'tautological tests' language to TQ-8) rather than TQ-1; finding already lists TQ-8 in labels so this doesn't change the verdict.
